definition: one provider holding several of my products, so one failure lands more than once

settled:
State Farm holds the house and the car both, so anything that goes wrong there lands on me twice over.

Cloudflare is the same shape: registrar, DNS, tunnel and certificates all on one provider.

Unbundling is low priority here, because every peer insurer is the same D and moving sideways buys nothing. Only something structurally different would, and none is open to me.

So I hold what I have and watch, and I would only move if a B-rated option appeared.

title: Putting Two Things With One Company
